ROOT_CAUSE: In `_cstack`, when the right operand is a `CompoundModel` (like `cm = Linear1D(10) & Linear1D(5)`), it recursively calls `_separable` which returns an array of shape `(n_outputs, n_inputs)` instead of calling `_coord_matrix`. This causes `right.shape[1]` to access the wrong dimension index for a 2D matrix.
OLD: cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1
NEW: if isinstance(right, Model): cright = _coord_matrix(right, 'right', noutp) else: cright = np.zeros((noutp, right.shape[1])); cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1
